caption: The video captures a nighttime outdoor scene lit by a warm yellow streetlight glowing from the upper frame, its hazy light spilling over dense dark-green foliage. A cluster of brighter yellow-green leaves sits in the lower-left corner and a thin vertical lamppost pole runs down the right edge, both fixed throughout. Heavy rain falls continuously across the frame as many short, bright vertical streaks descending against the dark backdrop. The downpour is already in progress at the opening and continues without pause, so neither its start nor its end is shown. At scattered intervals a single large, out-of-focus droplet appears as a blurred vertical smear at varying horizontal positions across the frame, catching the light as it travels downward past the lens. The glow, pole, and leaves stay aligned, indicating near-static framing through which the steady downward motion of the rain is the dominant visible process.
